description: This Kotlin source file defines the NoteShareDetailActivity class, an Android activity responsible for managing note sharing options, including permissions, expiration dates, labels, passwords, and sending notes within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles UI interactions, share creation and updates, and integrates with various helper classes and repositories.

classes.name: NoteShareDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for managing note sharing options, including permissions, expiration dates, labels, passwords, and sending notes. It handles UI interactions, share creation and updates, and integrates with various helper classes and repositories.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI binding, retrieves intent arguments, initializes the repository, and sets up the share process UI.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to UI components based on the provided color.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes such as screen rotations, especially for dialog recreation.

methods.name: showShareProcessFirst
methods.description: Displays the first step of the sharing process, configuring UI for permission settings.

methods.name: setupModificationUI
methods.description: Configures UI elements for modifying an existing share.

methods.name: setupUpdateUI
methods.description: Configures UI elements for creating a new share.

methods.name: updateViewForShareType
methods.description: Adjusts UI based on the type of share (email, public link, internal).

methods.name: updateViewForExternalShare
methods.description: Configures UI for external share types.

methods.name: updateViewForLinkShare
methods.description: Configures UI for public link shares.

methods.name: updateViewForInternalShare
methods.description: Configures UI for internal shares.

methods.name: updateViewForExternalAndLinkShare
methods.description: Adjusts UI for external and link share options.

methods.name: updateExpirationDateView
methods.description: Updates the UI to display the current expiration date of a share.

methods.name: updateViewForFile
methods.description: Configures UI for file sharing.

methods.name: updateViewForFolder
methods.description: Configures UI for folder sharing.

methods.name: showShareProcessSecond
methods.description: Displays the second step of the sharing process, mainly for note content.

methods.name: implementClickEvents
methods.description: Sets up click and change listeners for UI components.

methods.name: showExpirationDateDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to select an expiration date.

methods.name: showChangeNameInput
methods.description: Shows or hides the input for changing the share label.

methods.name: onCancelClick
methods.description: Handles the cancel button click, navigating back or resetting UI steps.

methods.name: showExpirationDateInput
methods.description: Shows or hides the expiration date selection UI.

methods.name: showPasswordInput
methods.description: Shows or hides the password input UI.

methods.name: getReSharePermission
methods.description: Builds and returns the permission flag for reshare.

methods.name: validateShareProcessFirst
methods.description: Validates user input in the first step of sharing configuration.

methods.name: getSelectedPermission
methods.description: Determines the selected permission flag based on UI state.

methods.name: createOrUpdateShare
methods.description: Initiates creation or update of a share based on current state.

methods.name: updateShare
methods.description: Performs the update of an existing share, including optional email notification.

methods.name: createShare
methods.description: Creates a new share with specified parameters.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Handles the result of share creation or update, showing success or error messages.

methods.name: onDateSet
methods.description: Callback for when an expiration date is selected.

methods.name: onDateUnSet
methods.description: Callback for when the expiration date is unset.
